title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 49.Underlines that Articles 6(2) and 6(4) of the European Climate Law oblige the Commission to assess whether all current measures, draft measures and legislative proposals, including budgetary proposals, are consistent with the EU’s climate-neutrality objective; recalls that according to the European Climate Law, the EU’s and Member States’ actions should be guided by the precautionary and‘polluter pays’ subsidiarity and proportionality principles established in the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union;
